reason: The original generic CLI accepted one arm name for both directions, while the frozen forward/reverse minimum-length arms are min8 and min3. The correction adds explicit optional reverse arm names and changes no rows, metric, parameters, models, splits or gates.
feature_flag_correction: A final prelaunch audit found that the human-readable labels off/on were passed directly to BIOHUB_EDGE_FEATURE_TTA, whose implementation treats every value except literal 0 as enabled. The runner now separates output label from literal flag value and fail-closed asserts off=0 and on=1. No inference had started and no metric was exposed.
bytecode_isolation: The forward and reverse src/scripts source manifests are identical after excluding generated __pycache__ files. The runner removes copied __pycache__ directories before installing and compiling the candidate predictor.
verification: Thirteen focused source, inverse-map, evaluator, reproduction, control, comparison and runner-contract tests pass after the literal 0/1 and bytecode-isolation corrections.
